# ChannelPan

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ChannelPan:Void channel:Int32, pan:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | In | Int32 | required | A channel handle from [PlaySound](PlaySound) or [PlayMusic](PlayMusic). |
| `pan` | In | Float32 | required | -1 is only left, 0 the middle and 1 only right. Values outside that range are limited to it. |

## Description

Moves a playing channel between the left and the right speaker. It can be called at any time while the sound plays.

## Differences

* Panning is done by turning down the opposite speaker, so the sound does not get louder when it is panned to one side.
* A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the channel was never given out. A channel that is over is fine everywhere, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
; MakeBeep writes beep.wav, see the LoadSound example for the code.
Local snd = LoadSound("beep.wav")
LoopSound snd
Local ch = PlaySound(snd)
For i = 0 To 100
	ChannelPan ch, Sin(i * 7.2)
	Delay 30
Next
StopChannel ch
```
